sql: SELECT TOP 10 p.SKU AS sku, p.ProductName AS name, p.PimProductId AS productId FROM dbo.ZnodePimProduct p INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishState ps ON ps.PublishStateId = p.PublishStateId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.StoreCode = @store WHERE p.ProductType = @productType AND p.IsActive = @isActive AND ps.PublishStateCode = @publishState AND EXISTS (SELECT pe.PublishProductEntityId FROM dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity pe INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity ve ON ve.VersionId = pe.VersionId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog pc ON pc.PublishCatalogId = pe.ZnodeCatalogId WHERE pe.ZnodeProductId = p.PimProductId AND pc.PortalId = po.PortalId AND ve.RevisionType = @publishState AND ve.IsPublishSuccess = @isActive AND pe.IsActive = @isActive AND pe.IsObsolete = @notObsolete AND pe.ProductIndex >= @minProductIndex) AND COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.Quantity) FROM dbo.ZnodeInventory i INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse pw ON pw.WarehouseId = i.WarehouseId WHERE i.SKU = p.SKU AND pw.PortalId = po.PortalId), @zero) >= @minStock AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT cl.PimProductTypeAssociationId FROM dbo.ZnodePimProductTypeAssociation cl INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct cp ON cp.PimProductId = cl.PimParentProductId WHERE cl.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND cp.ProductType = @configurableType) AND CHARINDEX(@space, p.SKU) = @zero AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT pr.PriceId FROM dbo.ZnodePrice pr INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceList pl ON pl.PriceListId = pr.PriceListId WHERE pr.SKU = p.SKU AND (pl.ActivationDate IS NULL OR pl.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (pl.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR pl.ExpirationDate >= @now) AND (pr.ActivationDate IS NULL OR pr.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (pr.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR pr.ExpirationDate >= @now) AND (EXISTS (SELECT plo.PriceListPortalId FROM dbo.ZnodePriceListPortal plo WHERE plo.PriceListId = pl.PriceListId AND plo.PortalId = po.PortalId) OR EXISTS (SELECT plf.PriceListProfileId FROM dbo.ZnodePriceListProfile plf INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalProfile ppf ON ppf.PortalProfileID = plf.PortalProfileId WHERE plf.PriceListId = pl.PriceListId AND ppf.PortalId = po.PortalId))) AND (@preferred IS NULL OR p.SKU = @preferred) ORDER BY p.SKU
